description: Stage 2: Noita liquids and gases (materials.xml), simulated on top of Terraria's tiles.

lifetime.desc: Gas lifetime in Noita frames (0 = forever).

touch_effects.desc: Noita status effects on touch (status_effects + stains).

touch_damage.desc: Noita hp units per frame while touching (player_base.xml; 1 unit = 25 hp; < 0 heals).

ingestion.desc: Noita status effects when drunk, TYPE:amount.

creative.desc: Shown in Noita's creative mode (a 'real' material, not an effect).

conducts.desc: Carries electricity (materials.xml electrical_conductivity; unset = Noita's engine default, see _unverified).

reacts_as.desc: Materials whose reactions it takes part in too (Noita _inherit_reactions up the _parent chain).

_unverified.conducts: materials.xml does not set electrical_conductivity: default assumed (liquid yes, powders and others no); ask the author
